headline: The 5 Most Interesting Analyst Questions From AbbVie’s Q2 Earnings Call
summary: AbbVie’s second quarter results reflected robust product performance but were met with cautious investor sentiment. Management credited double-digit sales growth to strong execution in core immunology therapies, especially SKYRIZI and RINVOQ, and notable gains in the neuroscience portfolio.
